comment: Canopy app catalog. Canopy reads this file from GitHub Pages instead of scanning org repos, so app repos can be private. Fields: id (stable app id), name (display name, styled by Canopy), description, tagPrefix (release tag in THIS repo is <tagPrefix>-v<version>), legacyRepo (org repo whose own releases are used while no <tagPrefix>-v* release exists here; omit when same as id), legacyAssetPrefix (zip filename prefix filter for multi-app legacy repos), appcast (filename in this repo, null if none), icon (path in this repo, null if none). To add an app to Canopy: add an entry here. To migrate an app's zips here: upload the release zip as a release of this repo tagged <tagPrefix>-v<version>.
